international.title: Briton swims length of strait of Hormuz to highlight environmental cost of war
international.summary: UN patron Lewis Pugh saw ships ablaze and fighter jets overhead during three-day swim as Iran conflict continues A British endurance swimmer has completed a three-day swim through the strait of Hormuz to highlight the environmental cost of the Iran war. Lewis Pugh, a UN patron of the oceans, swam the 9.3-mile (15km) length of the waterway, which is a key route for oil shipments from the Middle East. Continue reading...
